name: Fate-Binding Web
descriptionTemplate: Gain [Block:Arg1] Shield. Grant all other Awakeners [Energy:Arg2] Aliemus. The next {Eternal Weave} creates 2 additional {derived:Guiding Strings}; 1 in the Draw Pile, and 1 in the Discard Pile.
lore:
She had heard the sound of threads snapping countless times.
A reunion that never happened. A confession never spoken. A child never born.
A piece of music never brought to the world. A war never won. A civilization that never survived.
Threads weave. Threads snap. Threads converge back into that vast web.
The deity of fate has long known—nothing ever truly perishes, nothing ever truly existed.
